underlying_fact_rule: Drive owns the stored source object; semantic/domain authority still follows the fact-class contract.
mutation_rule: Provider mutation requires provider-specific read-before/write/readback evidence when A7 actually changes that provider.
failure_rule: After three reasonable failures, record/defer this provider dependency and continue independent work without fabricating blocked facts.
public_registry_behavior: A7 may publish only approved safe Drive metadata/anchors. Detailed private topology remains in the governed Drive index and is queried live.
topology_resolution_order: live exact Drive provider object when current state matters
